description: This file defines the LoanSecurityShortfall class and functions for managing loan security shortfalls, including updating shortfall status, adding security pledges, checking for LTV shortfalls, creating shortfall records, and retrieving LTV ratios within a loan management system.

classes.name: LoanSecurityShortfall
classes.description: Represents a record of a loan security shortfall, inheriting from frappe's Document class.

methods.name: update_shortfall_status
methods.description: Updates the status of a loan security shortfall based on security value and loan details.

methods.name: add_security
methods.description: Creates a new loan security pledge document for a given loan.

methods.name: check_for_ltv_shortfall
methods.description: Checks for loan-to-value shortfalls across loans and creates or updates shortfall records accordingly.

methods.name: create_loan_security_shortfall
methods.description: Creates a new or updates an existing loan security shortfall record with provided details.

methods.name: get_ltv_ratio
methods.description: Retrieves the loan-to-value ratio for a specific loan security.

methods.name: update_pending_shortfall
methods.description: Marks a pending shortfall as completed.
